architecture: unchanged SB3 MlpPolicy [64,64] tanh, 37-D -> 3-D Gaussian; ONLY mlp_extractor.policy_net and action_net are trained (actor only); log_std frozen at -2.0; critic untouched.

dataset.split: by episode, 80% train / 20% val (seeded permutation, Stage-1-v2 split mechanism)

environment.asset: STATIONARY within an episode (v_s = 0); position is TRANSLATED (not moved during the episode)

translation.feasible_box: exact per-scenario box from the edge-spawn point and the origin-starting asset; no clipping, invalid targets are rejected (`TranslationInfeasible`) and a different scenario seed is tried
translation.mechanism: both the attacker's canonical perimeter-spawn position and the asset's origin are shifted by the SAME horizontal vector delta, drawn from a dedicated stream (tag 0xc4a2) independent of spawn/soldier/enemy/sensor/obstacle streams; relative geometry and the endurance budget (computed from the initial 3-D distance) are therefore exactly preserved

expert: canonical scripted A0 (direct_obstacle_only): normalized desired direction unit(p_asset - p_attacker) at the CURRENT (translated) state; no privileged/future information.
hypothesis: The Stage-4 moving-target failure was caused in part by inadequate dependence on asset-position inputs created by fixed-origin curriculum training. Randomizing the stationary goal location during expert imitation should produce translation-aware pursuit while preserving previously learned defender-evasion behavior.
mastery: two consecutive epoch validations pass ALL gate checks
observation_audit: a1_v2_obs_v1 (37-D) unchanged; no new features; translation tests whether the EXISTING asset-position slots (3-5) can be learned to carry goal information.

parents.note: accepted Stage3-v2 curriculum checkpoints (NOT the failed Stage-4/4A models)

stage4a.result: 0/3 mastered; asset-input sensitivity ratio only 2.1-2.5% PRE (Stage3-v2 parents), ~10% POST Stage-4A (393k PPO steps)

representation_gate.rule: for each PASSING seed: POST asset/attacker sensitivity ratio >= 2x PRE, AND no translation-generalization region captures below 95%

retention.stop: capture below the anchor minimum on 2 consecutive epochs on ANY anchor => retention failure

retention_dataset.label: parent policy deterministic mean action at the visited state
retention_dataset.source: reserved Stage3-v2 (moving-defender) scenarios, driven by the SEED'S OWN Stage3-v2 parent policy (not A0)

success_rule: >= 2/3 seeds master, representation gate passes, Stage1/2/3 retention holds, no shared pathology; < 2 => STOP, do not proceed to moving-asset imitation
tests: representation/curriculum intervention: randomized-origin goal conditioning by A0 imitation (NOT a new controller architecture, NOT PPO learn())
